infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Smart Agriculture uses the camera to photograph your crop leaves for disease analysis.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Smart Agriculture uses your location to fetch local soil and weather data and to place scans on your farm map.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Smart Agriculture to use the camera to photograph your crops.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Smart Agriculture to use your location to map scans and fetch local soil and weather data.
